touches.text: Knowledge: one list of nodes, owned by the librarian.

tools the device uses itself today (device.py, shim.py, logs_sweep.py; its machines not counted): base, system_word, liveness, bus_client, rack, operator_inbox, question, proof_coverage, instanceizer, data_recorder, charter, artifact; machine learning_block; db_domain client
Hollow runs: proves a proof goes red when the build is removed.
Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.

learning_block: the engine of a learning block (input → candidates → evaluate → decide or escalate). Used by many devices. Stays a shared machine. [Q#41: a machine with many holders, or a tool, since each holder keeps its own data?]
